one_liner: AI cleanup and 4x upscaling for product photos, built for e-commerce catalogs and batch workflows.
description: pixelmuse takes messy product shots and returns catalog-ready images: background cleanup, lighting correction, and 4x upscaling tuned specifically for product photography rather than portraits or art. A batch API processes whole catalogs overnight, and presets keep an entire store's images visually consistent.
target_user: E-commerce store owners and the agencies that manage their catalogs

icp.who: Shopify merchants and small e-commerce agencies managing 200-20,000 SKU images
icp.pain: Supplier photos arrive low-res and inconsistent, and neither generic AI upscalers nor manual Photoshop passes scale across a catalog
icp.buying_trigger: A store redesign, marketplace onboarding, or supplier catalog import that surfaces hundreds of substandard product images at once

differentiators: Models tuned on product photography — keeps label text and fabric texture crisp instead of painting over them
Batch API plus CSV workflow for whole-catalog processing, not one-image-at-a-time
Store-level presets keep every image in a catalog visually consistent
proof_points: 4x upscale of a 12MP product image in 9 seconds
Three Shopify agencies use it in their standard listing workflow

voice.sample_phrase: Supplier photos in, catalog-ready images out.

signals: Self-serve beta with credit billing live
Batch API documented but marked beta

gaps: No Shopify app store listing yet

confidence.notes: Speed and volume claims are plausible and demo-backed, but no third-party validation yet.
